column5: fact   (ALL PROTOCOL, COMMITTEE, DATE AND STAKEHOLDER FACTS BELOW ARE FICTIONAL DEMO DATA)

Product: Immunonco (fictional demo brand) for relapsed/refractory multiple myeloma; also relevant to cardio-oncology monitoring pathways. Approved label as summarised in the oncology label fact; use outside the label is off-label.

Allowed channels with pathway and P&T committees: (a) respond to written requests for information from committee members or the pharmacy; (b) provide the approved dossier via Medical Affairs / Market Access; (c) support a clinician-requested education session. The rep must NOT contact committee members to advocate for a pending vote, offer anything of value, or discuss pricing/contracting - route to Market Access / Managed Markets.

Pathway/formulary submission, contracting, pricing and access strategy: Market Access / Managed Markets key account lead. Off-label or unsolicited clinical data requests: Medical Information (1-800-000-0100, fictional). Possible adverse events: report per SOP within 24 hours.

Approved positioning language (fictional): 'Immunonco is indicated for adults with relapsed or refractory multiple myeloma after at least four prior lines of therapy including a proteasome inhibitor, an immunomodulatory agent and an anti-CD38 antibody.' Rep may offer the approved dossier and the REMS and monitoring workflow summary on request. Rep may not claim superiority over other bispecifics or CAR-T.

Demo protocol: Allina Health Oncology Pathways v2026.3, aligned to NCCN myeloma guidelines. Pathway tiers: Preferred, Alternate, Not on pathway. Immunonco is currently listed as ALTERNATE for 5L+ RRMM after triple-class exposure; Preferred status requires a pathways-committee vote. Physicians may use Alternate agents only with a documented reason in the pathway tool.
Demo timeline: dossier submitted 2026-08-14 (done); Oncology Pathways Committee review 2026-11-12 (next); P&T formulary decision 2026-12-09 (later). Written information requests close 2026-11-05.

Demo stakeholders: Dr. Elena Voss, Pathways Committee chair (hematology) - NEUTRAL, cares about OS/PFS evidence and toxicity management workflow, last contact 2026-09-18, asked for monitoring protocol summary; Raj Menon PharmD, P&T oncology pharmacist - BLOCKER, cares about total cost and site-of-care/inpatient bed use, last contact 2026-07-30; Dr. Hannah Brooks, service-line director oncology - CHAMPION, cares about patient access and referral volume, last contact 2026-10-08; Dr. Marcus Lee, community hematologist - CHAMPION, wants outpatient step-up logistics, last contact 2026-10-01; Priya Shah, value-analysis lead - NEUTRAL, cares about utilization and length of stay data.

Demo protocol: Atrium Health Hematology Care Pathway 2026, NCCN-aligned. Immunonco is NOT YET REVIEWED; a pathway change request must be submitted by a physician member, not by the manufacturer. The rep may supply approved information on request.
Demo timeline: change request not yet submitted (next); Hematology Pathway Council meets 2026-12-03; P&T meets 2027-01-14. Information requests accepted until 2026-11-20.

Demo stakeholders: Dr. Omar Haddad, Hematology Pathway Council chair - NEUTRAL, evidence-focused, last contact 2026-06-11; Lena Ortiz PharmD, system oncology pharmacy director - NEUTRAL, cares about REMS operations and inpatient capacity; Dr. Tom Alvarez, myeloma program lead - CHAMPION, interested in step-up dosing outpatient feasibility, last contact 2026-09-29.
